desc: Implement small-N brute-force BFS to obtain ground-truth minimum operations for all reachable/unreachable support pairs.
Use BFS data to identify the gap-operation model (boundary/internal gap reductions and endpoint shifts).
Derive and implement an O(N) DP/greedy over gap embeddings using component parity and boundary-cost optimization.
Implement the final full solver with fast I/O and validate on samples.
